name: Beach at dusk
desc: Endings and confessions - a wide empty stage with the light visibly running out.
tags: scenery, no humans, beach, low tide, wet sand reflecting sky, gentle surf, foam line, orange and purple sky, silhouetted headland, scattered shells, footprints in sand
prose: a wide beach at low tide, wet sand mirroring an orange and purple sunset sky, a thin line of foam at the waterline and a dark headland silhouetted at one end
note: Defaults to a noon tropical postcard. The tag that actually makes it dusk is wet sand reflecting the sky, not the word sunset. Keep the sun low or out of frame - a big sun disc in shot blows the exposure and crushes everything else to silhouette, which then fights the sunset grade instead of working with it.
